d.d: An additive secondary colour midway between green and blue, evoked by wavelengths between ~490 and ~520 nm.
Any compound containing the -C≡N group or the CN⁻ anion.
Sodium or potassium cyanide, used in the extraction of gold and silver or as a poison.
Hydrogen cyanide, or cyanide gas, a poisonous gas.
To treat or poison with cyanide.
The pseudohalogen (CN)₂; a colorless, poisonous gas used as a rocket propellant, an insecticide and in chemical warfare.
